name: ema-forge-cloudflare-study
description: Host, administer, message, and analyze an EMA Forge study with private Cloudflare R2 storage.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: REPLACE the masked example value with your own unique password of at least 32 characters. You will enter it on /admin. EMA Forge never receives or recovers it.

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Optional SMS: paste your Twilio Account SID (starts AC). Leave blank if you will share participant links yourself.

TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional SMS: paste your Twilio Auth Token as an encrypted secret. Never use a sample value.

TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Optional SMS: your Twilio sending number in +15551234567 format. Leave blank if using a Messaging Service.

TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID.description: Optional SMS alternative to a sending number: Twilio Messaging Service SID (starts MG). Leave blank when using a sending number.

STUDY_DATA.description: Private R2 storage for the installed study, roster, dispatch audit trail, and participant response records. Do not enable public bucket access.
